Ivy Park: hi all, new to oncall this rotation — couple of setup questions before my first live shift tonight. who do I ping for: 1) emergency contact numbers (incident commander phone list), 2) runbook edit access if I find a typo during a triage, and 3) whether I'm allowed to trigger the chaos-lab sim?
Noah Kim: welcome Ivy :wave: Emergency contact list is in Confluence -> Oncall -> Contacts. If you need the quick list now DM me and I can paste. Runbook edits: you can submit PRs to `runbooks` but only sign-offers (L2+) can merge. For urgent typo fixes during a page, put the fix in the incident notes and open a PR afterwards.
Rita Lopez: re: chaos-lab, new oncalls should not trigger full sims without a shadow. You can request a scheduled sim in the #eng-sre channel; we run low-impact sims on Saturdays. If you're shadowing, you can run the sandbox sim with a senior.
Ivy Park: thanks — also my PagerDuty mobile push shows "delivered" but I don't get sound. company MDM says no permission to override DND for apps. any workarounds?
Sam Rivera: if MDM blocks critical alerts, add a backup contact (work phone) in PD and enable email->sms fallback. Also enroll a secondary device (tablet) with PD and enable Critical Alerts there.
Noah Kim: quick incident checklist we expect on first response: 1) Acknowledge in PD, 2) run `runbook lookup <svc>` and paste the summary to #incidents, 3) set a short status line in the incident thread (sev|impact|next), 4) if no mitigation in 10m escalate to L2. Example command: ```
# find runbook and tail logs
runbook lookup payments-processor && kubectl -n payments logs -f deployment/processor --tail=200
```
Ivy Park: who do I CC in Slack when escalating? sometimes there are differing expectations across teams.
Rita Lopez: CC the service oncall alias (e.g., @payments-oncall), the primary SRE rotation (@sre-rotation), and `@incident-commander` if it's SEV1. We have a pinned escalation matrix in #eng-sre.
Ivy Park: one last thing — I found a small doc mistake in the runbook steps for service restart. Can I edit and push a PR now or should I wait?
Noah Kim: open a PR labeled `docs: runbook fix` and request review from the service owner. If it's urgent and blocking recovery, paste the exact command to #incidents and request a quick merge from a signer.
Oncall Bot: Reminder: Complete the "Oncall Basics" checklist and the "Incident Comms" micro-course before your second live shift to receive full escalation privileges.
